cases.description: 驗證整個 workspace 的 Rust 格式不會漂移。
執行 workspace 全部 target 的回歸測試。
Render and scroll 100,000 deterministic entries in list and wrapped GPUI view families under Release latency gates.
Verify bounded interaction-first scheduling, frame draining, stale-result rejection, privacy-safe observations, and overload degradation recovery.

Drive the public command/event protocol through explicit completion and frame gates, proving rapid replacement, bounded delivery, tab closure, and shutdown terminalization with privacy-safe diagnostics.

Run the deterministic 1,000-result fixture and production batcher/runtime/bridge/GPUI seam tests: 16-50 ms coalescing, overflow race safety, no per-item synchronous redraw, and path-free slow-callback identity.
Validate bilingual public jobs/value/stream/cache API and performance diagnostics guidance, including abi_stable author API versus host-internal boundaries.
Build and run the Rust-first public author fixture offline, proving sequence-zero batches/progress, echoed generations, returned ownership, credits, and status-specific terminals.
Verify a reliable retained terminal cannot overtake earlier breadcrumb or search batches from the same request.
Verify visible extension-backed files use their real filesystem paths for Shell icons instead of blocking on synthetic extension base paths.
Verify extensionless dotfiles use their real filesystem path for Shell icon lookup instead of the invalid synthetic path ending in a dot.
Open D:\UE_5.7 in an isolated rebuilt app and require .gitignore and .editorconfig to replace the blue fallback with real Shell icons.
Verify non-name Details columns start marquee selection and marquee coordinates use actual laid-out bounds with scroll-content compensation.
Use genuine DPI-aware pointer drag input from a non-name Details column, require multiple selected rows, and prove all four marquee edges align with the physical pointer endpoints.
Use deterministic start/release gates to prove stalled file-operation and breadcrumb enrichment workers cannot delay navigation.
Prove an active isolated search worker has bounded cancellation-aware shutdown and releases retained thread resources.
以 warnings-as-errors 執行 workspace Clippy。
執行 workspace 文件測試。
禁止 production UI 重新引入散落的顏色、尺寸與座標 magic numbers。
驗證 Explorer reference 與 baseline comparator 的 region/color/icon/typography 判定。
驗證一般權限啟動、視窗生命週期、診斷 log 與程序正常離開。
重複啟動與關閉應保持程序、GDI、USER 資源乾淨。
驗證 panic 報告、production panic policy 與 ANSI-free 背景 log。
驗證背景、單選、多選、逾時、取消與原生資源釋放。
驗證 UI Automation 名稱、角色、焦點與選取模式。
驗證網址列、搜尋列與重新命名的 IME 輸入。
驗證跨資料夾切換後 F2 仍可重新命名且編輯框幾何正確。
Verify genuine secondary-click Back/Forward history menus, pointer-following neutral-gray hover, inherited tab history, Ctrl+T, and physical middle-click tab close.
驗證捲軸拖曳捕捉、滾輪與固定詳細資料標題。
驗證內容檢視格線與等距列、Details→Tiles→Content，以及四組各三階的 Ctrl+滾輪圖示尺寸。
擷取固定尺寸、明亮配色、真實資料夾的視覺證據。
在系統高對比狀態下驗證顏色與可讀性；狀態不符時腳本明確報告。
驗證 100/125/150/175/200% DPI 矩陣並保留每一級截圖與診斷。
只在至少兩個螢幕時執行混合螢幕視覺擷取，否則以明確原因 SKIP。
驗證 manifest、OpenSpec 掃描、coverage gate、timeout 與報告核心。
編譯整個 workspace 與所有 target，作為全部 active OpenSpec 的靜態回歸底線。
執行架構與 workspace 邊界檢查。
在 C: 與 D: 專用資料夾用真實 UI 驗證 Backspace、Ctrl、Shift、F2、Delete、分頁與搜尋快捷鍵。
在 C: 與 D: 隔離資料夾間導覽，驗證 native HWND、UIA 與工作列可見標題始終等於作用中完整路徑。
驗證 Cargo package/binary 分離、SuperExplorer VERSIONINFO、production consumer 名稱及既有持久化資料根相容契約。
驗證 Tab/Shift+Tab、Home/End、Ctrl+L、Ctrl+F 與 Alt+F4 的 headful 焦點路徑。
驗證 breadcrumb segment、chevron overlay、空白編輯與實際路徑提交。
Use a real modified Git working tree to verify TortoiseGit breadcrumb overlays survive a C:\ navigation round trip and the localized search hint follows the current folder.

Use two real tabs, UIA bounds, physical pointer movement and pixel evidence to verify current-folder tab icons, active/content continuity, breadcrumb hover tracking, and that navigation into a nested folder updates the Explorer-style search scope hint.
驗證 command bar 點擊、選取與滑鼠控制不造成非預期捲動。
驗證欄位排序、方向與欄寬拖曳。
驗證檢視模式、詳細資料窗格與預覽窗格。
驗證排序與檢視 popup 依各自按鈕實際座標定位，且不回歸視窗左上角。
驗證捲動後 Details 標題固定置頂與捲軸拖曳。
以真實 Git 工作樹驗證 TortoiseGit Shell overlay 像素與持久化圖示快取。
Verify left-button threshold initiation, Shift/Ctrl precedence, same/cross-volume defaults, typed folder/background routing, invalid targets, and cleanup.
Use genuine left-button input in one SuperExplorer window and prove default Move, Shift Move, Ctrl Copy, and Cancel against real disk state.
驗證 Explorer 與本程式間真實 OLE drag-and-drop。
驗證真實 Explorer 至本程式的 OLE 移動。
驗證真實 Explorer 至本程式的 OLE 複製。
驗證真實 Explorer 至本程式的左右鍵 OLE 取消。
執行多分頁、十萬筆、檔案操作、Clipboard/OLE、右鍵選單與搜尋長時壓力測試。
以 UIA 驗證三個 mixed-location 分頁、獨立 history/view、active tab、window bounds、screenshots 與 10 次 clean/crash restart 的完整 before/after restore。
分階段驗證 thumbnail contracts、Shell sources、cache、DPI/visual 與 1,000 次 soak；script 尚未交付時明確 SKIP。
分階段驗證 Home、Quick Access、Known Folder、ZIP、Library、Recycle、Network 與第三方 namespace；script 尚未交付時明確 SKIP。
分階段驗證 broker protocol、process isolation、quarantine、migration、installer 與 hostile-worker soak；script 尚未交付時明確 SKIP。
Open and cancel one real brokered Windows Shell context menu, proving that only the intended popup is visible and the persistent supervisor remains console-free.
分階段驗證 preview lifecycle、broker host、focus/UIA、DPI/visual、real handlers 與 crash/hang soak；script 尚未交付時明確 SKIP。
Open the supplied image in a two-tab Explorer session across different paths and verify that the preview pane exposes a loaded UIA Image.
Validate parsed Everything query translation, bounded provider behavior, lazy SQLite scope/cancellation, and adaptive search fallback contracts.
Validate Details column/menu state, adaptive sizes, interactive navigation-tree state, tab isolation, and owned This PC presentation contracts.

Use UTIT/UI Automation to delete search text back to the directory snapshot, dismiss app-owned and selected-item Shell menus with Escape or outside click, verify foreground restoration, prove canonical volume roots are unique, and expand a navigation drive.

Capture canonical drive icons before and after opening This PC, select C: and prove the selected drive plus sibling drive icons remain visible, then expand D: and prove ordinary navigation folders use non-empty Windows Shell generic folder pixels.

Open This PC and switch through Details, Small/Medium/Large icons, and Content; verify Explorer-specific columns, bounded drive cards, full-width content rows, truthful capacity labels, screenshots, and normal drive activation.

Expand the active folder in the navigation pane, delete owned child folders externally and through Shift+Delete, and verify watcher and operation-terminal reconciliation remove stale rows without manual refresh.
Validate deterministic disposable filesystem corpus generation, Unicode and long paths, content controls, attributes, and cleanup scope guards.

Validate non-waiting Unicode process launch, structured rejection, exact post-validation installer handoff, no stale-output fallback, and non-blocking BAT exit-code forwarding without opening a real installer.
Exercise real filesystem enumeration, icon/list/details views, Unicode names, search refresh, and deep navigation against the generated corpus.
Probe real NTFS hard links, alternate data streams, junction cycle guards, and privilege-dependent symbolic links with truthful skips.
Verify F2 Unicode rename, Shift/Ctrl selection, Ctrl+A, copy, cut, paste, Backspace, Delete, Shift+Delete cancel/confirm, and F5 using disposable disk-state oracles.
Copy a folder onto a same-named destination folder, require the native Explorer conflict chooser, and prove Cancel preserves both destination-only and conflicting content.

Verify Shift+Delete opens an accessible modal with neutral-gray Cancel/Delete focus, Tab+Enter and pointer Cancel preserve the file, focused Enter removes it exactly once, and the native request never enables recycle or undo flags.
Verify New menu population and pointer activation with collision-safe text naming plus real Folder and bounded Data recipe disk effects.
Validate a 2,000-item directory, refresh-generation convergence, cold/warm startup, cache corruption recovery, and bounded process resources.
Run the opt-in 20,000-item large-directory, refresh cancellation, cache recovery, and resource-bound soak.
Open the labeled Other and Extensions controls, prove popup exclusivity, validate installed/unavailable TortoiseGit state, invoke refresh, and preserve visible state.

Verify Open, Cut, Copy, Copy path, Create shortcut, Delete, Rename, Share, Quick access pin, and Properties are returned as typed host commands where applicable and routed through long-lived Explorer actions.

Use genuine DPI-correct right-clicks on non-first rows, then invoke Cut, Copy, Create shortcut, Delete, Rename, and Properties; validate exact targets plus owner-centered, work-area-safe native property sheets.

Use genuine pointer clicks and partial drag selection in the address, padded search, and inline rename editors; require a baseline-sized address caret, stable caret insertion, near-full-height selection with symmetric physical-pixel margins, selected glyph coverage, dark unselected glyphs, exact padded hit-testing, and opaque Explorer Highlight pixels.

Use genuine Windows keyboard input in the address, search, and inline rename editors; verify Shift+Home, Shift+End, Shift+Left, and Shift+Right through exact selected-range replacement assertions, including full-line selection and selection contraction.

Capture every real ordinary and Shift menu entry for background, file, folder, and multi-selection targets; require unique bounded actionable IDs and classify each as application-owned or provider-owned.
Compare brokered and direct native context-menu results and validate one async supervisor, serialized disposable workers, timeout, crash, cancellation, and console-free process isolation.
Prove the constrained extension worker can launch a user-selected external Shell command without inheriting the one-process Job limit or returning ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_QUOTA.

Use genuine pointer input to replace an open native popup, prove the exact second target through Clipboard results, preserve background/multi-selection/dismissal behavior, and enforce ten-cycle resource bounds.
Restore a two-tab high-DPI session containing a bare drive designator, physically right-click a non-first item without topmost assistance, and prove native popup plus canonical root persistence.
Verify expanded navigation children retry missing Shell icons and pointer context menus target the stable hit item identity instead of a stale or first row index.
Validate structured lock classification, bounded Restart Manager discovery, protected-owner policy, modal reducer races, retry identity, and destructive semantics.

Use real locked owned files and Restart Manager helpers to verify modal UIA, keyboard focus trapping, Retry, Escape, pointer Cancel, multiple owners, graceful Close programs and exactly-once delete retry.
Run ten native popup cancellation and ten Restart Manager helper cycles while proving menu/window, helper, worker, session, drag, handle, GDI, and USER resources return to baseline.
Run the offline P0 plugin tooling unit contract.
Build and load the ABI host/plugin fixtures from the offline vendor tree.
Build separate host/plugin DLL fixtures offline and verify typed values, stable sort keys, outcome policy, opaque schema binding, malformed-input rejection, and foreign allocation cleanup.
Exercise the shipped plugin build/validate/package wrapper contract.
Verify the UI ABI fingerprint contract rejects a mismatched plugin fingerprint before loading.
Reproduce the documented P0 validate/build/package commands against the shipped fixture.
Run the isolated offline v1 package manifest and publisher-contact contract.
Run deterministic package-source discovery, provenance, reparse, and bounded-scan contracts.
Validate strict v1 manifest, contact, signature, and payload rejection paths through the shipped offline contract.
Verify the bilingual lifecycle schema reference and illustrative resolution manifest remain internally consistent.
Run the sealed package resolver integration contract with its isolated offline Cargo home.

Seed two recovered native-call markers beneath an isolated LOCALAPPDATA-shaped UITEST root, start the real feature-gated SuperExplorer binary, prove Safe Mode denies callbacks before confirmation, then verify path-free suspect identity and exact keyboard/UIA confirmations.
Verify guarded native callback cleanup, synthetic abandoned-marker recovery and confirmation, bounded slow-call diagnostics, and drain-timeout restart behavior.
Run the production generation-aware extension result cache tests and audit watcher, TTL, manual refresh, data-version invalidation, and stale-admission rejection paths.
Run production InputStream capability, bounded read/seek/length, cancellation/deadline, generation and retained-handle behavior tests.
Validate stable built-in/extension ColumnIds, descriptor registry validation, collision rejection, and ordered layout foundation (persistence migration is task 5.4).
Load the independent public-SDK Size Map plugin, select its production View entry, render percentage rectangles over a real folder, and recover after F5.

Load the canonical Rust folder-size visual column with a deterministic sample tree, require completed exact values and ordinary shell DataItems, verify numeric sorting, toggle the proportional bar through the header setting, and recover after F5 without stale-generation presentation.
Load the independent public-SDK Rust tokei plugin and verify exact Code lines values, numeric sorting, public-render-context bars/details, and ordinary shell icons.
